title: Wanwood
body:
Description

The Wanwood tree is one of the various trees that grow on Ferwater Island, it appears as a tall tree with a very green trunk and a small crown. They can be found almost anywhere in Ferwater except in the desert area. It's a beefier tree so it should take a few swings with an axe to bring down. The sanded version of the log has a sage-olive green color.

Like most materials in-game, it can be used in schematics.
